title: Layout stops lecturing and starts fitting
goal: The Layout section is by far the tallest thing in the properties panel: 269 points for a copy of a component and 489 for an original, and most of that is a paragraph of prose spelling out an arrangement the rows above already state. It pushes everything below it off the bottom of the panel. It should say the same thing in a fraction of the room.
notes: Measured 2026-09-06 in a 1200x720 window: for a component copy Layout ran 568-837, for an original 697-1186. Sample body text: "Everything in this copy stays where the original put it. It keeps 10 top, 16 right, 10 bottom, 16 left clear inside its edges. It is 36 tall." plus Arrangement/Horizontal/Vertical rows. Source is PlacementInspector.swift. This bulk is what buried the Component section (task the-dock-opens-on-the-section-that-answers-the-l, which moved Component above it rather than fixing this).
acceptance: The Layout section is no taller than Position and Size for a selection that is not using auto layout
The paragraph explaining the arrangement is gone or reduced to one short line
Nothing that could be set before can no longer be set
A playtest walk reads the section height back and proves the number
